facts.fact: The minister said a national cybersecurity agency (Agence nationale de cybersécurité) has been created by presidential ordinance to strengthen the national response to digital threats; the source gives no date for the ordinance, so the publication date is used.

The minister acknowledged that the DRC already faces cyberattacks and said the Centre national de cybersécurité intervenes on some situations; no incident or date is given, so the publication date is used.
